name: Classic Spinach & Cheddar Omelette
description: A fast, protein-packed omelette with wilted spinach and sharp cheddar.
instructions: 1. Whisk eggs with a splash of milk, salt and pepper. 2. Melt butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat. 3. Pour in eggs, let set for 30s, then add spinach and cheddar. 4. Fold and slide onto a plate.

name: Garlic Butter Chicken with Lemon
description: Pan-seared chicken breast in a glossy garlic-lemon butter sauce.
instructions: 1. Season chicken and sear in olive oil 5-6 min per side. 2. Remove, lower heat, add butter and garlic. 3. Squeeze in lemon, return chicken, spoon sauce over. 4. Rest 5 min, garnish with parsley.

name: Tomato Basil Spaghetti
description: Weeknight spaghetti with a bright 15-minute fresh tomato sauce.
instructions: 1. Boil spaghetti until al dente. 2. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil. 3. Add chopped tomato, simmer 10 min, season. 4. Toss with pasta and basil, finish with parmesan.

name: Shakshuka
description: Eggs poached in a spiced simmer of tomatoes, onions and bell peppers.
instructions: 1. Saute onion, bell pepper and garlic in olive oil. 2. Add cumin and paprika, then tomato; simmer 12 min. 3. Make wells, crack in eggs, cover and cook until set. 4. Scatter cilantro.

name: Chicken Caesar Salad
description: Crisp romaine, grilled chicken and a creamy yogurt Caesar dressing.
instructions: 1. Grill seasoned chicken, slice. 2. Blend yogurt, garlic, lemon, parmesan and pepper for dressing. 3. Toss romaine with dressing, top with chicken and croutons.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Soft paneer cubes in a smooth, lightly spiced spinach gravy.
instructions: 1. Blanch and puree spinach. 2. Fry onion, ginger, garlic in ghee; add tomato and garam masala. 3. Stir in spinach puree and cream, simmer 8 min. 4. Fold in paneer, warm through.

name: Veggie Fried Rice
description: Cold-rice fried rice loaded with carrot, peas and scrambled egg.
instructions: 1. Scramble eggs, set aside. 2. Stir-fry carrot and garlic in sesame oil. 3. Add cold rice and peas, splash soy sauce. 4. Return eggs, toss with scallion.

name: Caprese Stuffed Bell Peppers
description: Roasted bell peppers filled with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
instructions: 1. Halve and seed bell peppers, roast 15 min. 2. Fill with diced tomato, mozzarella and garlic. 3. Roast 12 min more. 4. Finish with basil and a balsamic drizzle.

name: Greek Yogurt Pancakes
description: Fluffy, tangy pancakes made lighter with Greek yogurt.
instructions: 1. Whisk yogurt, eggs, milk and vanilla. 2. Fold in flour and baking powder. 3. Cook on a buttered griddle until bubbles form, flip. 4. Serve with honey.

name: Minestrone Soup
description: A hearty Italian vegetable and bean soup, great for using up produce.
instructions: 1. Sweat onion, carrot, celery and garlic in olive oil. 2. Add tomato and broth, simmer 15 min. 3. Add pasta and beans, cook 10 min. 4. Stir in spinach until wilted.

name: Chana Masala
description: Chickpeas simmered in a tangy tomato-onion masala.
instructions: 1. Fry onion, ginger, garlic until golden. 2. Add tomato and dry spices, cook to a paste. 3. Add chickpeas and water, simmer 20 min. 4. Finish with garam masala and cilantro.

name: Carrot Ginger Soup
description: Silky blended carrot soup with warming ginger.
instructions: 1. Saute onion, garlic and ginger. 2. Add carrot and broth, simmer 20 min. 3. Blend smooth with coconut milk. 4. Season and serve.

name: Margherita Flatbread
description: Quick flatbread pizza with tomato, mozzarella and basil.
instructions: 1. Brush flatbread with garlic oil. 2. Top with sliced tomato and mozzarella. 3. Bake at 230C for 10 min. 4. Finish with fresh basil.

name: Thai Basil Chicken (Pad Krapow)
description: Fiery minced chicken stir-fry with holy basil, served over rice.
instructions: 1. Pound garlic and chili. 2. Stir-fry with minced chicken over high heat. 3. Add sauces and sugar, toss in basil. 4. Serve over rice with a fried egg.

name: Eggplant Parmesan
description: Layers of breaded eggplant, marinara and melted cheese.
instructions: 1. Bread eggplant slices in egg and breadcrumbs, bake until crisp. 2. Make a quick garlic tomato sauce. 3. Layer eggplant, sauce and cheeses. 4. Bake 25 min until bubbling.

name: Lemon Garlic Butter Shrimp
description: Ten-minute skillet shrimp in lemon-garlic butter.
instructions: 1. Pat shrimp dry, season. 2. Sear in olive oil 1 min per side, remove. 3. Melt butter with garlic and chili flakes. 4. Return shrimp, add lemon and parsley.

name: Spinach & Feta Quesadilla
description: Crispy quesadilla with garlicky spinach and salty feta.
instructions: 1. Wilt spinach with garlic. 2. Fill tortilla with spinach, feta and cheddar. 3. Cook in butter until golden both sides. 4. Slice into wedges.
